panels.title: Mean wall time per query

targets.query:
import "strings"
from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "polars_query_duration" and (r._field == "sum" or r._field == "count"))
  |> group(columns: ["label", "_field"])
  |> sum()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["label"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({query: r.label, n: int(v: strings.trimPrefix(v: r.label, prefix: "tpch/q")), "mean wall": r.sum / float(v: r.count)}))
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["n"])
  |> drop(columns: ["n"])

panels.description: Mean of every run of each labelled query, from polars.query.duration histograms.

panels.description: CPU time over wall time over cores: 1 keeps every core busy.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "polars_node_cpu_time" and r._field == "sum")
  |> group(columns: ["node_kind"])
  |> sum()
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({"node kind": r.node_kind, "cpu": r._value}))
  |> sort(columns: ["cpu"], desc: true)

panels.title: Slowest query, per flush

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "polars_query_duration" and r._field == "upper")
  |> group()
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 10s, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "slowest"})
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "slowest"])

panels.description: The longest query finishing in each 10 s Telegraf flush. Telegraf summarises each label separately, so percentiles cannot be combined across queries.
